presets.name: Spoken voice
presets.note: 80 Hz: below the voice, above traffic and handling noise.

presets.name: Deep voice
presets.note: 60 Hz keeps the chest of a low voice.

presets.name: Close microphone
presets.note: 120 Hz tames the bass build-up of a microphone held very close.

presets.name: Phone recording
presets.note: 150 Hz: a phone or video-call voice has nothing useful below it.
